title: Efficient Key Recovery from Multiple Trivium Superpolies
summary: Multiple superpolies are known for 846- and 847-round Trivium, but efficiently combining them to recover key-bit information remains open.

formal_statement.body: Multiple superpolies have been recovered for both $846$-round and $847$-round $\mathrm{Trivium}$; develop an efficient method that uses multiple such superpolies to recover information about the key bits.

scope.domain: Cube-attack and algebraic cryptanalysis of reduced-round Trivium using multiple full-key superpolies.
parameters: 846 and 847 rounds: the reduced-round Trivium instances for which multiple superpolies were recovered
80 key bits: all secret variables involved in the relevant superpolies
Multiple recovered superpolies: the relations to combine for efficient key-information recovery
scope.unresolved_remainder: Find an efficient method for jointly using multiple recovered superpolies to obtain information about the key bits.

citations.label: Stretching Cube Attacks: Improved Methods to Recover Massive Superpolies

progress.summary: The paper reports recovering multiple superpolies for both 846- and 847-round Trivium and explicitly asks how they can reveal key-bit information. The relevant superpolies are neither linear nor quadratic, involve all 80 key bits, and have no known disjoint set.
citation_labels: Jiahui He et al., Stretching Cube Attacks: Improved Methods to Recover Massive Superpolies
